sentence_1_it: Non gli dire nulla riguardo al cavallo.
sentence_1_en: Say nothing to him about the horse.
sentence_2_it: Io ho detto a Tom che dovrebbe accettare l'impiego che gli ha offerto Mary.
sentence_2_en: I told Tom he should consider taking the job Mary offered him.
sentence_3_it: Per piacere, gli dica che ho chiamato.
sentence_3_en: Please tell him that I called.

sentence_1_en: Ought I to tell it to him?
sentence_3_en: I'll be sure to tell him.
